verdict.rationale: First-party docs say that signing in to your Google Account on a new device automatically syncs your codes to it. There is also a documented QR-code transfer path from old to new device. Community users independently confirm the QR export of all codes and that cloud syncing now exists. Older complaints about upgrades wiping tokens, and about phone backups excluding codes, concern different mechanisms and do not contradict the documented transfer. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that cloud sign-in migration carries over every token without gaps, and detail on the guided flow's steps for users who opted to use the app without an account.

support.subject: As an everyday user, moving to a new phone transfers all my tokens in one guided step

citations.quote: When you sign in to your Google Account within Google Authenticator on a new device, your codes are automatically synced to this device.
On your old device, create a QR code... On your new device, tap Scan QR code
Google Authenticator has a feature to allow export of all saved codes into one QR code for re-import into Google Authenticator running on another device.
